description:
"Recently filming for The Younger Heroes Camp 2017 around the base of Mt Warning, Australia. We were capturing footage of the sunrise with the DJI Mavic Pro Drone. Bird are generally attracted to the drone maybe because we are in their airspace?

This morning we were privileged to have three Peregrine Falcons come and take a look. A little research tells us that this bird is the fastest in the animal kingdom, 389km diving speed. It catches its prey in mid flight.

We were filming at 4K 25fps which makes it hard to get a fluent slow motion of the interaction, but we loved what we captured."
